name: Better Planet Generation
summary: A huge planet generation overhaul that aims at making your hundreds of hours of exploration in the magnificent, infinite universe of No Man's Sky less repetitive and hopefully even more memorable.
author: WoodyMontana
description:
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][i][b]                                                     [size=6]Better Planet Generation[/size][/b][/i][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1629738968-1312445652.jpeg[/img]

[size=4][b]More planets

[/b][size=3]Better Planet Generation is a total overhaul of the planetary generation in No Man's Sky.[/size] [size=3]It improves by a significant margin the procedural aspect of the universe while at the same time respecting the original work and vision from Hello Games.[/size]

[size=3]It adds thousands of new distinct environments to the universe[/size][/size]. All of them come in five different life levels and varying placement scales and layouts. These environments were made to seamlessly combine with each other in many different ways.

Better Planet Generation is designed to bring variety to the different biomes you will visit but most of all it brings a lot of variation to the universe. Outside of the countless combinations of assets and their resulting new environments, planets you visit will present themselves differently each time. Placement layouts, scale of the regions, density, variety of assets and their respective scale, ...

No planet will look exactly the same. Unless, of course, it is a very simple one. More on that below.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1631005159-472402214.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630936034-1789086190.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1610300150-1298994048.jpeg[/img]


[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=4][b]Sub Biomes[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

Caves and underwater sub biomes have also been entirely overhauled.

Tons of new variants have been added underground and just like on the surface, additional objects can spawn to increase variety even more.

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630410276-924973523.jpeg[/img]﻿

Underwater has been completely revamped and is now generated through a triple layered dynamic framework combining assets to generate highly varied and detailed environments.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1629738939-165524032.jpeg[/img]
[b][size=4]
Unique planets

[/size][/b][size=4][size=3]On top of all the added variety, BPG also uses a flexible dynamic generation framework that can take many shapes[/size][/size] and create countless planetary variations, even when the same environments are being used multiple times.

Each planet generated has its own selection of parts based on its biome. Some liberties have been taken when designing and attributing those parts to the various biomes. Some objects have been injected to improve variety, but some restrictions have also been applied to preserve each biome's identity. Better Planet Generation also introduces countless restored, modified or repurposed assets to the game in order to increase the variety while preserving its visual style.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630936068-132859967.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630936034-754906087.jpeg[/img]

[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=4]Natural Generation[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size]

Better Planet Generation is a vastly different experience compared to the unmodded game and even other biome mods.
Not even taking into account the small details, it is more than likely that you will never be able to encounter all the possible assets combinations this mod can generate. Let alone in the different regional layouts each dynamic template can result in.

Each biome has access to multiple procedural templates. Each producing different results in terms of layouts and objects combinations.
Their common goal is to show you a different kind of environment each time. Aesthetically and structurally.
No more "postcard" planets where most of what there is to see is right around the corner. The scale of the generation can get extremely vast compared to the vanilla game.

Planetary generation can now affect your visual enjoyment and the gameplay.
It is a video game, after all.

A world generated at its fullest possible level and highest complexity can take you some time to fully explore on foot. Meaning seeing the most notable regions (and not all of them) and scanning everything.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630052272-1155900954.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1610300150-2086924238.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630272224-118529207.jpeg[/img]
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=4]More Variation[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

On the other hand, Better Planet Generation also allows more simple, generic yet still visually interesting planets to see :

- Planets only covered in grass and some plants, rocks or both.
- More barren worlds dominated by giant stone or crystal spires.
- Radioactive wastelands.
- Planets dotted with trees or occasional small forests.
- Volcanic wastelands.
- Toxic fields.
- Rocky swamps.
- ...

And the list goes on and on.
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3]The occurence of these "generic" planets only relies on probabilites. None of my templates is designed to specifically produce them.
I made sure they still looked good, though.[/size][/size][/size][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630410296-1590906166.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1626079315-1486130072.jpeg[/img]

[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=4]Different Experience[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

Better Planet Generation is not for everyone. Planets can be both very detailed in every aspect or very simple.
If you expect to always see trees and a full grass coverage on your Lush planet or anywhere else, there are other mods for that.
This is not what you should expect using BPG.

Now, whether you are a new player ready to explore an infinite universe or a more weathered one that wants to be surprised by the game again, I suggest you give Better Planet Generation a try. It won't harm your game in any way.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1629923717-282604290.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630410307-2137550589.jpeg[/img]

[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=5]WARNING BEFORE INSTALLING :[/size][/b]

Installing this mod will operate changes to the terrain in every biomes.
It is also recommended to install it while in a space station / anomaly / freighter and not on a planet's surface.
Some major updates to the mod can reset the terrain or biome lists.
I'll include a warning on the download page and the sticky when it's the case.[/size][/size][/size][/size]


Recommended :
[/size][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/968]DUD's Sky - Colors[/url] : load planetary colour palettes before BPG to avoid procedural textures conflicts.
[/size][/size]

name: Blackbody Stars
summary:
Makes green stars white. Adjusts the colors for blue and red stars to reduce the whitewash.
Stars are more vibrant and higher contrast as well, so should be friendlier for people with common R/G or B/G color-deficiencies.
author: HAX
description:
Stars are made of fire and it does not contain all the colours of the rainbow (normally).
Fire uses something called the blackbody spectrum and notably, it contains only red, yellow, white and blue.

This mod adjusts the colors for the 4 different star types:
- green stars are instead white
- blue and red stars are much darker and more vibrant

Depends on the StarPaint mod. Stars will be drawn using the full range of possible colors in the blackbody spectrum instead of just
the 4 basic colors.

A high contrast version is available that should be friendlier for people with common R/G or B/G color-deficiencies.

[i][b]*IMPROVED IN THIS VERSION*
[/b][/i]Higher fidelity colour range: increased 16x

Recommended Mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/638]Black Space[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/626]No Space Dust[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/626?tab=files]No Space Plasma[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/495/]Black Map[/url]


[color=#ff0000][b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b][/color]
[color=#ffff00][i]- NMS v2.0+ (BEYOND)[/i][/color]
[color=#ffff00][i]- Hax StarPaint [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/878]link[/url]][/i][/color]


[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]INSTALLATION:[/size][/color][/b]
This mod requires the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/878]StarPaint[/url] mod to be installed.
The zHaxStarPaint pak is included in the zip. You should be able to replace it with the most up-to-date
version of StarPaint if the version included is outdated.

Install the [b]zHaxStarPaint[/b] pak.
Install ONE of the colormap paks. Do not install any other colormap paks.
If you have any others installed, you should remove them.

Choose one of:
- [b]HaxStarPaintMap-Blackbody.pak[/b]
uses pale colors that are not too intense for a more natural appearance.

- [b]HaxStarPaintMap-Blackbody-Vibrant.pak[/b]
same colors but much brighter and more vibrant.

- [b]HaxStarPaintMap-Blackbody-HC.pak[/b]
High contrast version of HaxStarPaintMap-Blackbody.pak.

- [b]HaxStarPaintMap-Blackbody-Vibrant-HC.pak[/b]
High contrast version of HaxStarPaintMap-Blackbody-Vibrant.pak.

name: Project Atlas - Alien Skies for Synthesis
summary: This mod adds 6000 new sky/weather color palletes tables to the game , that are generated using carefully controlled procedural generation.This mod allows multicolor skies, day time specific colors, sunrise/sunset specfic colors and more.Fog colors during storms, height fog, distance fog etc are all thematically colored based on sky coloring too.
author: thegamer3006
description:
[center][b]PROJECT ATLAS UNIVERSE GENERATOR: ALIEN SKIES MOD
[/b][/center][b]
                                   [/b][center][b] --------------------------FULLY PROCEDURALLY GENERATED MOD. NOTHING MADE BY HAND--------------------------[/b][/center]
[b]ABOUT: [/b] This is a procedurally generated mod, part of my Project Atlas universe generator, that I designed for No Man’s Sky. This mod focuses on adding procedurally generated sky color palettes to the planets in No Man’s Sky. This mod is part of my Project Atlas Universe Generator for No Man's Sky. To know what Project Atlas is , check this reddit post that contains details about it.

https://www.reddit.com/r/NoMansSkyTheGame/comments/96gyi4/introducing_project_atlas_your_very_own/

the vanilla game has only 5 shades of day sky colors and 1 shade of sunrise/sunset colors, hence i made this mod to add thousands of new shades of sky colors to the game, to add diversity.

[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]

[b]GAME VERSION SUPPORTED:[/b] The mod works with No Man’s Sky Synthesis Update and above.

[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[b]FEATURES OF THE MOD:[/b] 

These are some of the salient features of the mod.


• 6000 carefully generated,unique sky and atmospheric pallete colors in each version.
• 6 different versions.
• Some planets have themed atmospherics, where all aspects of the planet sky colors are beautifully linked to each other.
• Truly alien looking atmospheres are possible
• Maximum of 3 colors possible on a given day time per planet, which also varies with time of day and position of sun.
• The light color of a planet has a 25% chance of being linked to the actual color of the sun of the planet. Hence, a blue sun has a 25% chance of giving planets that has blue colored planet lighting and so on.
• Dense, procedurally colored fog is possible, giving really good visuals.
• Fog colors can vary with distance and can have 2 to 3 colors depending on the time of the day.
• Increased brightness versions have a chance of creating really vibrant planets.
• Procedurally colored clouds, with some really nice looking thunder cloud colors also possible with the mod.
• Sometimes, there is a chance of getting dim planets, that give a creepy , alien vibe.
• Cloudless planets are possible when clouds blend with the sky.


[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]

[b]VERSIONS OF THE MOD:[/b] 

The mod has 2 main version and 3 sub versions of each main version, total of 6 versions, each version adds 6000 unique, procedurally generated sky color palettes to the game that affects all aspects of a planet’s atmosphere colors like clouds, sky, sun , planet light color ,atmospherics of the day time, atmospherics of sun rise and sunset, dawn and dusk sky colors etc….

[b]Main versions:[/b] The mod has the following 2 main categories: 

[b]VANILLA BRIGHTNESS:[/b] This folder contains mods which have the planet light brightness not more than that of vanilla planet light color. Hence, the maximum brightness of planets in this version will not exceed that of vanilla game. Choose this if you don’t want to bright planets in terms of atmospherics.

[b]INCREASED BRIGHTNESS:[/b] This folder contains mods which have the planet light brightness more than that of vanilla planet light color. The brightness of planets will be about 50% more than that of vanilla planets most of the times, resulting in very vibrant planets like those in the atlas rises version of game and before. It also has chances of creating planets with vanilla brightness or less too. Choose this if you prefer planets that are vibrant and bright most of the time.


Now each of the above two main versions has 3 sub versions , once you pick which level of brightness you want, select one of the 3 sub versions from the respective folder.
 
1) [b]_PROJECT_ATLAS_ALIEN_SKIES_MILD.pak[/b] - this version adds only visually appealing sky atmospheric colors, which are photogenic and look good both when playing and in screenshots. Use it if you want good looking planets almost all the time. There is a chance that 1 in 10 or so planets can be truly alien. But otherwise , this version will give mild,light colored sky and planet atmospherics.

2) [b]_PROJECT_ATLAS_ALIEN_SKIES_NORMAL.pak[/b] – this version has the features of the above version, plus there is a chance that 1 in 5 or so planets will have alien looking atmospherics. Use this if you want a greater chance of alien type atmospheres, but have a good chance of finding visually appealing planets.

3) [b]_PROJECT_ATLAS_ALIEN_SKIES_TRULY_ALIEN.pak[/b] – This version has a chance of 1 in every 2 or 3 planets to have really alien looking atmospherics. Less chance of getting mild skies and greater chance of getting truly alien sky and planet atmospherics. Gives a really sci-fi alien vibe to the planets. 
Choose only one of the mod versions and place them in the MODS folder to make the mod work.

[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b] 

the mod alters the following files and as such won’t work with any other mod that alters the same file: 

[b]GCSKYGLOBALS.GLOBALS.MBIN
METADATA\SIMULATION\SOLARSYSTEM\WEATHER\SKYSETTINGS\DAYSKYCOLOURS.MBIN
METADATA\SIMULATION\SOLARSYSTEM\WEATHER\SKYSETTINGS\DUSKSKYCOLOURS.MBIN[/b]

[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]

[b]INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]

1) Select only one of the six mod versions
2) Create a MODS folder in the GAMEDATA/PCBANKS/ folder of your No Man’s Sky install directory. Make sure to delete the DISABLEMODS.txt in the PCBANKS folder to make mods work.
3) Place the selected pak file in the Above MODS folder and play.

[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[b]BUGS:[/b] 

If any bugs are encountered, leave a comment on the mod page and I will get to it when I have time.

[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[b]CREDITS:[/b]

@EXOSOLAR  - for giving nice suggestions and inputs for the mod.

[center]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------     [/center]

name: HD Space Planet Clouds 2.2
summary: High-Res planet clouds as seen from space
author: Lo2k
description:
This mod is an overhauled atmospheric cloud texture based on Scooterbaga 's [url=https://nomansskymods.com/mods/hd-clouds/][color=#f1c232]HD Clouds mod[/color][/url] 4K texture (8192x4096 pixels).

Scooterbaga's Nasa2 texture was very nice because it's a 4x version of the original game texture but looking at it more closely, I discovered it had a lot of issues here and there, so I did a big pass on it and tried to fix everything I noticed.

In details, this mod fixes the following issues from Scooterbaga's texture (see the last screenshot for a snapshot of my work) :
- removed a sometimes very visible seam appearing verticaly over all the planet at tiling position
- fixed tiling missmatch clouds
- filled holes, low transparency corrections and softened cloud cuts
- removed black dot lines, speckles and scratches
[color=#ffd966]
Note that it only improves long distance clouds as seen from space or from another planet, not the volumetric sky clouds.[/color]

Enjoy.

Optional :
- Add a slow pace rotation movement to your planet atmosphere with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1662][color=#f1c232]Rotating Atmosphere[/color][/url]


[color=#ffd966]history : v2.2 has been updated for 6.21 Remnant game version[/color]

name: Exosolar's and Babs' Beyond Base Building
summary: ★ FULLY MP compatible, this mod adds an extreme degree of freedom to the vanilla base-building options
author: Exosolar Sparky NeptuneX3 Babscoole
description:
[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]What is this Mod?[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]There are now almost 1,000 buildable base parts in vanilla No Man's Sky! It's a dream come true!
This mod adds an extreme degree of freedom to the vanilla base-building options.
This does NOT mean the mod gives you access to all buildable parts.  You still need to learn the blueprints for each.  :)
Beyond Base Building does NOT add any new build parts to the game.

Now includes all the functionality of gBase Items, [color=#ff0000]if chosen by running the Lua script[/color]:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]Can multiply power, extraction, and storage rates by 2, 5, or 10. WARNING: Bases built with this mod cannot be uploaded for multiplayer when using 2x, 5x, or 10x multiplied rates.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=4]EM Generators do not need a hotspot and produce 250 power.  Not enabled by default.  Must run Lua through ANUMSS and answer question "Choose a multiplier for Storage and Rates and EMAnywhere status" to generate custom mod file to enable.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]

It is [b]fully compatible[/b] with multiplayer, co-op building, uploading, etc, because it [i]does not add[/i] any parts, which would cause issues in multiplayer.[/size]

[size=4][color=#f1c232][b]★ Beyond Basebuilding[/b] is fully Lua scripted, with script provided for easy updating and merging [b]★[/b][/color] and carries over all of the official updates and improvements offered by Hello Games [b]plus[/b]:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]Most parts can be Scaled [i][color=#fff2cc]except[/color][/i] prefab building parts, [color=#fff2cc]Exocraft Geobays, Mineral/Gas Extractors and Base Computer[/color] (Door attachment points bug out when scaled, and issues persist with scaled base computers and geobays).  There may be others not listed.  Be aware, scaling breaks snapping.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Many parts can be built in a Freighter.  [color=#fff2cc][i]Exceptions[/i][/color]  include the Base Computer, Industrial Mining parts, Vehicle Summoners and planet-based teleporter.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Many parts can be built at a Planetary Base [i][color=#fff2cc]except[/color][/i] the freighter teleporter and the Orbital Exocraft Materialiser[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]All parts can be built above and below water[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]All parts can change color and material[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]All parts, which can be deleted, can be deleted without also deleting attached objects [color=#fff2cc][i]except[/i][/color] Decals and Posters[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]No build-count limits [i][color=#fff2cc]except[/color][/i] for parts related to resources harvesting, certain terminals, beacons and message capsules (and others with limits that are hard coded into the game, as they are added or changed by Hello Games).[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Unlimited Storage Containers[color=#cccccc][size=3][i]—*This does not increase actual storage amounts: Each numbered container acts as an index to the store rather than a physical box[/i][/size][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Foundation, Pavings and Communications Station can be placed anywhere (not only on bare terrain)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Non corvette parts buildable with corvettes[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]
Some customization of the mod is available just by running it through AMUMSS, where you'll be prompted about enabling several feature.  Even more customization can be had by editing the top portion of the Lua before processing.  See Lua usage below for link to AMUMSS install and basic usage How to.[/size]

[color=#f1c232][b][u][size=5]Disclaimer:[/size][/u][/b][/color]
[size=3]This MOD makes changes to the placement and usage setting of vanilla parts.  If the MOD is removed, the vanilla settings will be restored and parts that "violate" a vanilla setting as well as those connected may go "poof".  Best practice is to regularly backup your saves for semi-painless recovery from the unexpected.[/size]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1634/95741288-1598421367.png[/img][/center]

[size=5][b][u][color=#f1c232]Installation[/color]
[/u][/b][/size]
[b]Extract archive contents to GAMEDATA\MODS

[color=#f1c232][size=4][u]Lua usage[/u][/size][/color]
[size=4][b]✦[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2626]How to use AMUMSS at No Man's Sky Nexus - Mods and Community (nexusmods.com)[/url]✦[/b][/size][/b]

[size=4][u][b][color=#f1c232]Modified Files[/color][/b][/u][/size]
[color=#d8d8d8][size=3]METADATA\REALITY\TABLES\BASEBUILDINGOBJECTSTABLE.MBIN[/size][/color]

[i][color=#cccccc][size=3]Also check out...[/size][/color][/i]
[size=5]✦[b][color=#ffdd00][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/58018181?tab=user+files]Exosolar's Other Mods[/url][/color][/b]✦[/size]


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1634/95741288-1598421367.png[/img][/center]

[size=5][u][b][color=#f1c232]Is this Mod up-to-date?[/color][/b][/u][/size]
[size=4][i][b]Any mod files which are not hidden or demoted to the "Old Files" area can be expected to work.[/b][/i]
All uploaded files (on the Files page) are maintained with their packing date and version of the MBINCompiler used to pack it. Older mod versions, no longer compatible with the current version of No Man's Sky will be demoted to the "Old Files" subsection, but will remain available for download. There are no side-effects to using this mod.[/size]

[size=4][u][b][color=#f1c232]How to update, tweak, combine, or patch the mod with AMUMSS?[/color][/b][/u][/size]
[size=4]As this mod is now Lua scripted, you can [color=#fff2cc]easily [b]update[/b], [b]tweak[/b] or [b]merge[/b] the mod yourself[/color] (if a game update breaks this PAK of the mod, or you have other PAK or Lua mods that could conflict with this one). [color=#cccccc][size=3][i]—*Click on the spoiler below for more[/i][/size][/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3][u]Notes on AMUMSS:[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/957]AMUMSS[/url] tries to update [url=https://github.com/monkeyman192/MBINCompiler/releases]MBINcompiler[/url] automatically. If it fails to convert EXML/MBIN files, its likely due to a very recent NMS version update and MBINcompiler is awaiting an update too.
If so, I highly recommend you to disable your mods and wait for MBINCompiler to be updated (it's pretty quick in general).[/size]


[size=3][u][b][color=#f1c232]Updating the mod after a game update:[/color][/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][list]
[*] [size=3]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/957]AMUMSS[/url], and extract it locally,  avoid placing the AMUMSS folder in a path with special characters or in a system folder like [color=#fff2cc][i]"C:\Program Files (x86)\(...)"[/i][/color].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Place the mod Lua script (only the .LUA file, not the .PAK file) in the [color=#fff2cc][i]ModScript[/i][/color] folder of AMUMSS.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]AMUMSS will normally auto-detect the NMS installation folder, but you can also manually edit the path in the [color=#fff2cc][i]NMS_FOLDER.txt[/i][/color] file.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Launch [color=#fff2cc][i]BUILDMOD.bat[/i][/color] in the root of the AMUMSS folder and follow the steps, selecting the option to automatically install it in the NMS [color=#fff2cc][i]MODS[/i][/color] folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]A new modded PAK file will be created, using the last update of the MBIN game files duly amended by the script.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3]Most of the time simply recompiling the mod using the Lua script will make it compatible again. Use the latest script to ensure you adopt any mod adjustments to accommodate the latest NMS build.[/size][size=3] There are two main causes of mods not correctly updating with this method:
1) MBINCompiler needs an update to be able to decompile the latest version of the game MBIN files.
2) Structural changes have been made to the MBIN files called by this Lua script. Whilst unlikely, this will require some script rewrite and other mods are likely affected.[/size][/spoiler]

[size=3][u][b][color=#f1c232]Tweaking the mod:[/color][/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Use the same process as described in [color=#fff2cc][i]Updating the mod[/i][/color].
Just modify the script as you want before recompiling it. Look at the top of my scripts, you can generally edit modifiers there, or even disable/enable some features very easily.[/size]

[size=3][color=#cccccc][i]*[url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or [url=https://code.visualstudio.com/download/]VSCode[/url] are generally recommended to read EXML and Lua files, due to large file support and automatic highlighting. The [url=https://sourceforge.net/projects/npp-compare/]Compare plugin[/url] for Notepad++, and Lua is also a must-have to highlight file differences.[/i][/color][/size][/spoiler]

[size=3][u][b][color=#f1c232]Combining mods that provide Lua scripts:[/color][/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]You'll want to do this if multiple mods affect the same MBIN file.[/size]

[list]
[*] [size=3]Place all the scripts in the [color=#fff2cc][i]ModScript[/i][/color] folder of AMUMSS.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Launch [color=#fff2cc][i]BUILDMOD.bat[/i][/color] in the root folder of AMUMSS.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Follow the step, selecting that you want to combine all the scripts into one PAK file, and the option to automatically install it in the NMS [color=#fff2cc][i]MODS[/i][/color] folder.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3]AMUMSS will output a PAK file that will contain the modifications of all the scripts.[/size]
[color=#cccccc][size=3][i]*If the scripts modify the exact same values in the MBIN file, the last loaded script will overwrite the preceding script values.[/i][/size][/color][/spoiler]

[size=3][u][b][color=#f1c232]Patch in the mod to make it compatible with other PAK files:[/color][/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]You will want to do this if another mods isn't Lua scripted, and affects the same MBIN file as the Lua scripted mod.

It will work when :
Case 1) you patch a Lua scripted mod for only one other PAK.
Case 2) you patch a Lua scripted mod for several other PAKs, but only if the other PAKs don't modify the same MBIN files between them.[/size]

[size=3][b]How to create a patched PAK:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [size=3]Copy the script and the other mod(s) PAK(s) in the [color=#fff2cc][i]ModScript[/i][/color] folder of AMUMSS.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Launch [color=#fff2cc][i]BUILDMOD.bat[/i][/color] in the root folder of AMUMSS, and follow the steps, selecting the option to automatically install it in the NMS [color=#fff2cc][i]MODS[/i][/color] folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The new PAK file will contain all the Lua script modifications, and a compatibility patch for the other mod(s) PAK(s).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Rename it something like [color=#fff2cc][i]"__zzz Scripted Mod Name -Patched For- The Other Mod Name.pak"[/i][/color].[/size]
[size=3][color=#fff2cc][i]"__zzz"[/i][/color] prefix is to ensure that it'll be loaded after the mod(s) it was patched for (for NMS loading order, underscore [i]"_"[/i] came after every other characters).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Remove the original scripted mod PAK from the [color=#fff2cc][i]MODS[/i][/color] folder, and copy both the new patched one, and the other mod(s) PAK(s), into it.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][u]Notes:[/u]
[b]Be sure the mod PAK you want to create a compatibility patch for, is updated for the latest NMS version.[/b]
-> When AMUSS find an MBIN file affected by a script and by a PAK in the [color=#fff2cc][i]ModScript[/i][/color] folder, it will take the MBIN file from the mod PAK over the original one of the game, and will apply to it the modifications listed in the script.
So, if the MBIN file of the mod PAK is not updated, the one in the resulting patched PAK won't be either.[/size][/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1634/95741288-1598421367.png[/img][/center]
[color=#f1c232][u][b][size=5]Philosophy[/size][/b][/u][/color]
[size=4]All the erroneous limitations in building are pretty silly, aren't they? In making this mod, I paid specific attention to making sure I did not make changes that will invalidate the bases built with it from online play. Any base made with Beyond BaseBuilding will be fully viable and visible in online play, even when other players don't have this mod! It does this by only editing placement rules while you are in the building editor and not modifying any of the actual base parts themselves.
We hope you enjoy the mod and naturally, your comments are most welcome. We can also be found on the No Man's Sky Discord or reached directly at: [color=#f1c232]Babscoole #6326 [/color]or [color=#f1c232]Exosolar#5120[/color], or if its about the Lua script: [color=#f1c232]NeptuneX3#8095[/color] [size=3][i][size=4]or [/size][/i][/size][color=#f1c232]s p a r k y#0536[/color][/size]

name: Jetpack Joyride - Beyond
summary:
Is that a tin can strapped to your back, or a Jetpack? And those boots, son, are they even real rocket boots?

This mod changes several aspects of the Jetpack and enhances the Rocket Boots for No Man's Sky - Beyond. It comes in two flavours Normal and NoSafety.
author: Tollazor
description:
Is that a tin can strapped to your back, or a Jetpack? And those boots, son, are they even real rocket boots?

This mod changes several aspects of the Jetpack and enhances the Rocket Boots. It comes in two flavours Normal and NoSafety.
The Jetpack has increased speed, less drain, faster recharge and is more responsive, making it a viable option for travel, whilst hopefully keeping the exocraft relevant.
It is an extension to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/650]Ataxia's Jetpack Overhaul mod.

[/url]Both versions have the same Jetpack changes, how the two versions differ is in the Rocket Boots.

Jetpack Joyride - Normal:
This version enhances the Jetpack and also gives the Rocket Boots some much needed love making them a useful tool to reach those higher places or to give yourself a little extra Kick to your next jump. The Rocket Boots are fairly easy to control and don't threaten to splatter you all over the ground upon landing.

Jetpack Joyride - NoSafety:
This version also enhances the Jetpack, however against the advice of our engineers you have taken the safety off and dialed the Rocket Boots up to 11.  This gives the Rocket Boots a serious boost to the heights and speeds you can reach. Be warned though, it isn't for the faint-hearted, you need to be a bit more precise in your jetpack fuel usage so you don't find yourself plummeting to your inevitable death.

Please leave a message if you notice any problems or have any questions.
Underwater Jetpack remains the same as vanilla, however I will be enhancing those in the next version once I can test the modifications to those.

For No Man's Sky - Beyond.

This mod makes changes to GCPLAYERGLOBALS.GLOBAL.MBIN, and will not be compatible with any other mod that changes this file .. unless you merge them with one of the easy to use mod merge tools for No Man's Sky.

Version 1.0a - Reduced melee boost time slightly,  still higher than vanilla.
Version 1.0   - Initial Release

name: ZRatCraft - Flight Modifications 2.22
summary:
This mod increases your starship flight speed, turn rate and adds reverse.
Landing circles are red if not able to land, and green to land as usual. Landing adjustments
since you fly faster. Cruise control to unboosted flight speeds and loot range increase.
author: Ratan Kabidge
description:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Yes, another one. I am well aware there are others out there of similar effects, but
I re-balanced the ideas to suit my preferences, perhaps this will work for you as well.
Updated with MBINCompiler 2.22.0-pre4 for Synthesis 2.22.

-Doubled the flight speed from default values on planets, in space and in combat.
-Tripled the boost speed from default values on planets and in space.
-Reverse is possible on planets and in space. 
-Increased turn rate by 1.5x since I found double or more caused too much reduction in accuracy.
-Tripled landing speed maximum (80 to 240) since you are moving much faster now. 
-Reduced the ship inclination when you land, should remain fairly level now.
-Changed invalid landing state on landing pads to be red instead of blue for more contrast.
-Doubled Ship trail brightness and doubled the speed required for them to appear.

2.22 Update: Adjusted for Synthesis. Increased valid docking distance 50%, and 50% warp speed 
     and 50% thrust, and 10x space looting range.
2.16 Update: Now adds cruise control to standard flight speeds (not boost speeds).
2.15-1.01 Update: Increased trail initiation speed to 240 to match landing minimum speed and
returned the brightness to default values to adjust for user observations (Thanks LisbethSAO!).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Files effected in this MOD are:
\GCSPACESHIPGLOBALS.GLOBAL.MBIN
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installation, as always:
1) Create the MODS folder within  ...No Mans Sky\GAMEDATA\PCBANKS if it does not exist.
2) Unzip and copy the "ZRatCraft - Flight Modifications 2.15.pak" file to the MODS folder.
3) Rename or delete the DISABLEMODS.TXT file if it exists.
4) Start the game and fly like a bat out of hell.
-Rat

name: Better Rewards
summary: Increase the amount of currency you get with faster word learning and increased resource gathering options. Frigate (Freighter) Expeditions are also included!
author: MrTrack
description:
Better Rewards increases the amount of units, nanite clusters and quicksilver you get from completing missions or interacting with objects in the world. Non npc word learning (such as knowledge stones and dictionaries) is also faster.

[color=#bf9000][size=3]IMPORTANT NOTE: Don't use this mod when I haven't updated it to the new game version (especially when it is a new or returning expedition)
[/size][/color][color=#bf9000]if you really want to use it when I haven't updated it yet, make sure you [/color][color=#bf9000]back up your save[/color][color=#bf9000] or build the mod using the lua scripts yourself.[/color]

[b]Currency[/b]

Currency gain is roughly increased by 5 times, so as to make it a viable option besides crafting and selling valuable trading goods. Some unit values were tremendously increased (eg.: from minimum amount of 1000-2000 to 20000-50000) like the terminals in abandoned settlements to make the early game less grindy.

Includes:
[list]
[*]Space station missions and Nexus missions
[*]Interactable objects/devices (abandoned buildings, damaged machinery, waypoints, etc.)
[*]Sentinels
[*]Alien interactions
[/list]
[b]Words[/b]

Learning words from non npc interactions (knowledge stones and dictionaries) is also 3 times faster (3 words learned form a single knowledge stone). You now also learn 5 Atlas words, instead of 1 and also have a chance (15%) to learn them when interacting with non npc learning sources.

[b]Resources

[/b]When gathering with the mining beam you generally get 2 times more resources (but only when the things explode as you mine them). Also includes containers, depots, guild rewards, asteroids and ships that drop resources.

[b]Frigate (Freighter) Expedition Rewards

[/b]After a successful expedition, when collecting your rewards you get 5x more units and nanites, 2x more products like Storage Augmentation and NipNip Buds and 3x more resources like Copper, Emeril and Cadmium.
[b]
Installation

[/b]Make sure you delete or edit DISABLEMODS.TXT in your game library (...\Steam\steamapps\common\No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\PCBANKS) before trying to use mods. Extract the zip file to ...\Steam\steamapps\common\No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\MODS folder and you are good to go (Create MODS folder if you don't have one). Alternatively you can just use Vortex to download and install.

This mod modifies the [color=#ff0000][size=3]REWARDTABLE.MBIN[/size][/color] and [color=#ff0000][size=3]EXPEDITIONREWARDTABLE.MBIN[/size][/color] file and will not work with other mods that use those tables.

[b]Updated to NMS version 6.21 (Build ID: 21918502) on 2026.02.13.[/b]

name: NomNom
summary: NomNom is the most complete savegame editor for NMS but also shows you additional information around the data you're about to change. You can also easily look up each item individually to examine its attributes, independently of a savegame, or get other useful information that are not related to a specific one (but enhanced if one is loaded).
author: zencq
description:
[color=#e69138][size=3][b]NomNom is now in beta state.[/b] This means for you that some things may still not be 100% finished but the general state of the tool is a lot better than before.[/size] If you encounter bugs or when you think something doesn't work as expected or could be improved, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1566?tab=bugs]let me know[/url]![/color]

[color=#ff0000]All available features are tested while implemented but mistakes can happen, so be aware of that and backup your saves![/color]

The features can be divided into the different main parts:
[list]
[*][b]Manager[/b] Manage your saves!
[list]
[*]Automatic backup.[/*]
[*]Save your save as human-readable JSON.[/*]
[*]Copy, move, and swap slots to another.[/*]
[*]Delete your save.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Editor[/b] Edit your save for your needs!
[list]
[*]Ability to manage fleets, change data values like currencies and stats, and organize inventories.[/*]
[*]Ability to fast travel to any system you like, trigger space battles, and clear portal interference.[/*]
[*]Ability to edit your knowledge and recorded experiences.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
Have a look at the screenshots as well, to see what NomNom is capable of.

Each version of NomNom is built with the latest game version (at that time) in mind and the version number is reflecting that. Each one is also backwards
compatible down to [b]Beyond 2.11[/b] and even saves before that can still be edited via the build-in JSON editor. If you use it with a newer game version branch than
the one it was built for (e.g. [b]7.00[/b]), things should work as usual in most cases but there can always be a breaking change.

NomNom is compatible with every platform No Man's Sky is available on (some work better than others though). You can select a specific account/folder with you saves or, for platforms on PC, one level above if you have multiple accounts. A complete and always up-to-date overview with additional notes can be found [url=https://github.com/zencq/libNOM.io?tab=readme-ov-file#getting-started]on GitHub[/url].


[b]Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]After downloading and extracting the zip file you'll find a few files. All you need to care about is the executable ([b]NomNom.exe[/b]) but new folders may    be created at runtime (e.g. for backups) that will become relevant to you.[/*]
[*]You may want to create a shortcut to the executable for easier access.[/*]
[*]As the tool includes an automatic backup functionality you don't need to do it manually but if you want to be absolutely safe, do it.[/*]
[*]At first start the tool locates your saves at the default location of each platform but if that fails, you must select it manually.[/*]
[*]Select a slot.[/*]
[*]Start tinkering![/*]
[/list]

If you like NomNom and want to support me in its further development, you can do so via the donation options above or on [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/cengelha]Buy Me a Coffee[/url], [url=https://github.com/sponsors/cengelha]GitHub[/url], [url=https://ko-fi.com/cengelha]Ko-fi[/url], and [url=https://www.patreon.com/cengelha]Patreon[/url]. I will appreciate it!
There won't be a paywall though.

The is also a dedicated [url=https://discord.gg/nomnom-762409407488720918]Discord[/url] server where you'll find all information in one place, firsthand. Please read the rules first, to gain full access. If you need (or want to offer) help, found a bug, have a suggestion, or something else regarding NomNom, you will find, or can post it there.

Issues created here on Nexus Mods or via another channel will of course also be addressed.


Header image by [url=https://patreon.com/Orioto]Orioto[/url]﻿.

name: Step No Man's Sky - NMS - Guide
summary: Step Modifications is a community-driven organization of hobbyists providing and maintaining modding-related how-to guides with a focus on those wanting a stable, hassle-free, enhanced vanilla experience. Here, we present our No Man's Sky Guide, providing the Resource Files.
author: The Step Team
description:
[center][font=Verdana][size=6][b]Step Modifications - No Man's Sky Guide[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3]A lightweight, enhanced-vanilla overhaul for NMS[/size]
[b][color=#e06666]Supported Version:[/color][/b] [i][color=#ffe599]NMS:Voyagers v6.01+
[/color][/i][size=5]-> [url=https://stepmodifications.org/wiki/Step_No_Man's_Sky_Guide]Step No Man's Sky Guide Link[/url]﻿﻿﻿ <-[/size]
Also see our mod-build guides for other games:
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/mods/74193]Fallout4 Guide[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/newvegas/mods/73236]FalloutNV Guide[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrim/mods/11]SkyrimLE Guide[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/31054]SkyrimSE Guide[/url]﻿﻿[/size][/center]

[color=#e06666][size=6][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color]
The [b]Step No Man's Sky Guide[/b] is for users who would like an enhanced, vanilla feel. The Guide provides gameplay that is still true to the spirit of the game while enhancing aspects that are somewhat (or a lot) lacking. The Guide also favors a more relaxed exploration and gameplay style that was the original game before a great deal of combat and other elements were introduced. As such, adjustments are made toward that end, but never completely removed. This means many annoyances are reduced without completely nullifying any gameplay elements.

The [i]scope[/i] of the Guide is to combine desired changes from various mods and our Resource Files. The Resource Files make up a large portion of the Guide and stem from over 200 hours of extended gameplay. They cover and combine what would be a wide range of individual mods into one source.

[size=4][b]Important Links[/b][/size]
-> [url=https://www.stepmodifications.org/forum/]Step Modification Forums[/url]
-> [url=https://stepmodifications.org/wiki/NoMansSky:4.0/changelog]Current Changelog[/url]
-> [url=https://stepmodifications.org/forum/topic/20524-v40-feedback-bug-reports/]Feedback & Bug Reports[/url]
-> [url=https://www.facebook.com/StepModifications/]Facebook[/url]

[b][size=4]Disclaimer:[/size][/b]
[i]The Guide is aimed toward PC players with higher-tier systems. Mid-tier systems can likely run the Guide with some sacrifice to visual quality. However, users with low-end systems may find some performance issues.[/i]

[line]
[b][color=#e06666][size=6]Guide Features[/size][/color][/b]
Following are more details about what features this Guide provides, whether by mod or our Resource Files:

[b][size=5]Optional Files[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]StepNMS-Darker Space[/size][/b]
This originated from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1722]CSO's[/url] [i]Darker Space.[/i] Within our option, Step has tweaked the parameters to make space even darker while keeping nebulae and storms balanced to the darker space environment; specifically, space and fog colors are darken by 80%, nebulae colors by 30% and nebula cloud colors by 50%. This is optional because the changes deviate from vanilla; however, Step believes these changes provide a truer representation of space for those that desire it.


[b][size=5]Resource Files[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]AI Spaceship Globals[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased minimum circle time before landing
[*]Decreased chance of broken inventory and tech slots on broken ships to 50%
[*]Decreased the angle the ship will tip back while landing
[*]Increased the speed the ship rotates while docking
[/list]
[b][size=4]Environment Globals[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Clouds have been slowed down by 50%
[*]New cloud generation to prevent cloud columns; keeping them more flat
[*]Creature, Flora, and Terrain fade times adjusted to be a bit faster
[/list]
[b][size=4]Gameplay Globals[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Refiners are 20x faster vs vanilla
[*]Ship interaction range increased from 50u to 500u
[*]Freighter battles (when exiting warp) happen 50% less often vs vanilla
[*]Reduced flashlight/torch strength to reduce blowout when close to objects
[*]Moved torch more in front of the player to reduced it lighting the back of the head as easily
[*]Terrain Resource compass and scanner ranges increased
[*]Binocular Zoom levels increased by 50%
[*]Binoculars will scan further away and complete the scan faster
[*]Mining and Terrain beam distances increased to mine further away
[*]Survey scanners will scan further away and complete the scan faster
[*]Number of creature baiting and feeding for the tutorial reduced by 50%
[/list]
[b][size=4]Graphics Globals[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Forcing the loading of uncached terrain, which aids in the stopping of cached terrain issues
[*]Increased planet particle render range by 50%
[*]Increased distance shadows are drawn on freighters, planets, and space station by 50%
[*]Increased anisotropic filtering by one level for each game setting (low=4 / med=8 / high=16 / ultra=16)
[*]Increased the amount of terrain blocks loaded per frame by +1x1grid for each game setting (low= 5x5 grid / med= 6x6 / high=8x8 /
ultra= 9x9 grid)[/list]
[b][size=4]Hazard Table[/size][/b]
It's all too common for new players to try to take on a planet only to die before they can even find enough resources to survive the first storm! Since players are guaranteed to start on a hazardous planet, Step found the default hazard protections severely lacking in good judgement and balance. Our logic for our changes takes into account that one possesses the technology to travel the stars. Combine that with the significantly high chances of hazardous planets, and it would be logical to think the player would be better equipped vs vanilla. Overall, these adjustments will allow players to survive more comfortably in harsher environments:[list]
[*]Increased the protection time for all hazards to 900; default=540
[*]Rebalanced the hazard damages to shields and life support. All damages without a shield are slightly higher than damages to a shield.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Player Globals[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]The player swims, walks, and runs faster
[*]Jetpack & Rocket Boots are faster and last longer
[*]Jetpack has more forward thrust to use it more easily for travel
[*]Increased "Low G" environment character speeds (e.g., derelict freighters, dead planets)
[*]Jetpack's drain on Life Support has been reduced
[*]Probability of flyby Pirate attacks reduced by 50%
[/list]
[b][size=4]Sky Globals[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Increased length of time for the warning before a storm occurs
[*]Increased length of time that it takes for storms to transition
[*]Removed fog from planets without an atmosphere
[/list]
[b][size=4]Solar Generation Globals[/size][/b]
The asteroid fields have been completely overhauled. Overall the fields will be more sparse vs vanilla. The asteroid orientation has been changed, as well. Players will find smaller asteroids nearer orbital bodies with the larger asteroids starting to appear further out. Keep in mind that each system's generation will still be unique so some systems may have more or fewer asteroids than others. Other changes include: 
[list]
[*]Mined resources are increased by 2x
[*]Space between planets and asteroid fields is doubled
[*]Chances to find Capital Ships during scans increased and chances for Pirates decreased
[*] Probability of finding empty systems in Blue, Green, and Red stars decreased
[*] Probability of finding Pirate systems in Red and Yellow stars decreased
[/list]

[b][size=5]Benefits from the Mod List[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Bases and Buildings[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Increased base and base building radii
[*]Base item limits and restrictions have been removed for most items
[*]Most build-able items can now be rotated, scaled, change color, and change material
[*]Removing most base items will no longer remove attached items (prevents rework)
[*]Increased the minimum and maximum buildings the ship will scan for
[*]Unknown buildings and icon range increased
[/list]
[b][size=4]Scanners[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Clear binocular view (no vanilla tint)
[/list]
[b][size=4]Environmental[/size][/b]
[size=3][b]Planet[/b][/size]
Other changes include:
[list]
[*]Improved and expanded water colors
[/list]
[b][size=4]Gameplay & Miscellaneous[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Customized camera shakes (many have been disabled, others reduced)
[/list]
[b][size=4]Ships & Vehicles[/size][/b]
A significant bit of testing and tuning went into reworking the ship controls. The goal was to separate the ships a bit more by weight class for all settings vs vanilla, which solely relies on thrusts and brakes as the only differences. The "[i]Normal[/i]" weight class was set and used as the median between the [i]Lightweight [/i]and [i]Heavyweight [/i]classes. The lightweight ships should feel lighter and faster. Likewise on the other side that scale, the heavyweight ships should feel heavier and slower than their normal and lightweight counterparts.

This weight class deviation was already somewhat implemented in vanilla between lightweight and normal ships; however, the heavyweight ships had nearly the same controls as the normal class. What Step has done is taken what the developers executed between lightweight and normal ships and expanded upon it. This was accomplished by adding equivalent negative adjustments to the heavyweight class. All three weight classes should feel more distinct now.[list]
[*]Land, Boost, Pulse, Space, and Warp speeds are faster
[*]Narrowed the tracking for Pulse auto-aim.
[*]Pulse will exit closer to Space Stations
[*]Ships can now hover on planets and come to a full-stop and reverse in space
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=6][center]The Step Guide Mandate[/center][/size][/b]
[b][size=5]Step Modding Guides[/size][/b]
Step Modifications offers complete, stand-alone mod-build guides (aka, "Game Guides) for [url=https://stepmodifications.org/wiki/Property:Game]supported games[/url]. The Step Guides provide step-by-step instructions, resulting in Step's vision of an enhanced, vanilla gameplay experience. Furthermore, the guides offer optional [url=https://stepmodifications.org/wiki/Property:ModGroup]'ModGroups'[/url] and [url=https://stepmodifications.org/wiki/SkyrimSE:Step_Patch_-_Conflict_Resolution/2.3]patches[/url], allowing the Step build to be used as an extensible foundation for further customization.

[b][size=4]Step Guides are about ...[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]... bug fixes and corrections to malfunctioning aspects of the vanilla games.
[*]... HD asset replacements in the style of the vanilla game (or as close a representation as possible).
[*]... improvements to existing content that increase the consistency of the vanilla game.
[*]... interface mods that improve the menus and UI for the PC.
[*]... tweaks that improve consistency in gameplay or meet realistic expectations of intended game features.
[*]... new content, assets, and effects that are consistent with the game's style and lore, as established by Bethesda's creators
[*]... continuity and qualitative consistency of all in-game behaviors and assets (i.e., sounds, textures, models, gameplay, etc.)
[/list]
[b][size=4]Step Guides are NOT about ...[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]... sex mods, body replacement mods, or beauty mods that [i]unrealistically affect or digress[/i] from the ambiance and style of the vanilla game.
[*]... sound replacement mods that digress from the game's vanilla ambience.
[*]... texture mods that significantly deviate from the game's original visual style.
[*]... mods that are only required for a specific user base (i.e., a mod that fixes UI issues but only for users running at 4K)
[/list]
[line]
[b][center][size=6]User Contributions[/size]
[size=3]How YOU Can Help[/size][/center][/b]
[size=3]Step Modifications is always looking for volunteers willing to help out. We need help at many levels from mod suggestions and testing to forums management and release coordination. Please jump over to the [url=https://www.stepmodifications.org/forum/]Step Community forums[/url] and DM any of the staff there ... or just jump into the mix and help out as you are able[/size].

files.changelog_html:
MINOR VERSION CHANGES

The Tech Enhanced Guide has been converted into an official Guide for Step Modifications. With this conversion, the version has been reset to being in Beta. Though in beta, the Guide has been successfully tested and used for some time as it developed under the "Tech Enhanced" name. It will work its way back to a v1 release when more feedback is received from the community. The below changes are listed for those users returning to expect an update to the "Tech Enhanced Guide". These are the changes that happened during the conversion:

General ===================================================
- Asteroid fields shapes are more flat.
- Asteroid drawing distance increased.
- Increased space between individual asteroids.
- Space between planets and asteroid fields is doubled.
- Space colors are now ~60% darker. The colors remain, but it's more of a tint. Now space looks a bit more like space instead of colored fog.

Added the following mods:
- Black Carbon
- Integrated Planets
- Natural Nights
- Rotating Atmosphere

name: Instant Text Display - ITD
summary: This mod displays the text pretty instantly when interacting with objects or aliens (NPCs). Compatible with NMS "THE SWARM" v.6.44 (Steam's build 23583900).
author: NooBzPoWaH - Backing vocals by Babscoole
description:
[center][size=3]This mod simply displays the text pretty instantly when interacting with objects or aliens (NPCs).

If you leave the left mouse button pressed (players with keyboard/mouse, or the A button for XBOX 360 controller's users),
the text will be displayed even faster, if that's even possible.[/size]


[size=3]**************************************************************************************[/size][/center]



[center][b]Compatibility[/b] : 

[size=4][color=#00ffff]Compatible with [b]NMS "[url=https://www.nomanssky.com/swarm-update/]THE SWARM[/url][/b][/color][url=https://www.nomanssky.com/2024/10/expedition-sixteen-the-cursed/][color=#00ffff][b]"[/b] v.[/color][/url][url=https://www.nomanssky.com/release-log/]6.44
[/url][color=#00ffff]( Steam's Build [/color][url=https://steamdb.info/app/275850/depots/]23583900[/url] [color=#00ffff]).[/color][/size][/center]
[center]
[b][color=#ff0000][u][size=4]3xperimental branch is not supported ![/size][/u][/color]
[/b]
[b]Modified File[/b][size=3] :[/size]

[b][size=3]METADATA\UI\SPECIALTEXTPUNCTUATIONDELAYDATA.MBIN[/size][/b]
 [/center]
[center][size=3]***************************************************************************************

Heavily inspired by "[url=https://nomansskymods.com/mods/faster-text-display/]Quantus Mod[/url]",
so all credits goes to him !


***************************************************************************************

[b]Installation Instructions[/b] :

Manually :

Put the "Instant Text Display" folder which is inside the archive ( .zip ) in your
[b][color=#00ffff]InstallPath\No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\MODS folder[/color][/b].
( and [b][color=#ff0000]Not in [/color][color=#ff0000]No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\PCBANKS\MODS[/color][/b] as it used to be )

or

Via Vortex ( Nexus new Mod Manager ) :

Just click on the "Mod Manager Download" button.

The Mod is provided as a replacement (MBIN)
since it's modifying the entire file.

New lua file provided for the new "[url=https://github.com/HolterPhylo/AMUMSS/releases/]AMUMSS[/url]" v5.4.1.1W+.
( Thanks to Makto, initial LUA & gh0stwizard, fixed LUA )


***************************************************************************************

[b]Uninstallation :[/b]

Such an awful thing to do...
Delete the "Instant Text Display" folder from your MODS folder, or
Disable/Uninstall and Remove via Vortex.
That's it. Bye Bye ! ;)


****************************************************************************************


[b][color=#6aa84f]Thanks to monkeyman192 for keeping updating his great tool "[/color][/b][b][url=https://github.com/monkeyman192/MBINCompiler/releases]MBINCompiler[/url][color=#6aa84f]".[/color]
[color=#f1c232]Thanks to all members of the [url=https://discord.com/channels/215514623384748034/610638164150976541]No Man's Sky Modding Discord Channel[/url] for their kind help and insight.[/color]
[color=#cc0000]All Credit goes to Quantus with all my Thanks as well for releasing his "Faster-Text-Display" Mod in the first place.[/color][/b][/size][/center]

name: Asteroid Overhaul
summary: Asteroid Overhaul modifies asteroids fields to be less intrusive, realistic and useful in gameplay.
author: Somnixer
description:
[size=5][b]Premise[/b]
[/size]Asteroids in NMS are very toonish and immersion-breaking. Most asteroid mods reduce the number of asteroids, but this mod considers gameplay and effects as well. [u]Destroying asteroids now requires that you progress by having good ship modifications. It also is meant to make mining asteroids an actual activity.
[/u]
[color=#cc4125]You may feel a big drastic change, as you're probably used to the default asteroids that do not take any effort to destroy. Just keep that in mind. 
[b]
[/b][/color][b]Changelog:[/b]
1.1 Updated for Expeditions. [i]Note: some aspects such as visual changes/effects and deadlier ship damage are not fully updated right now. [/i]
1.0 Initial release for Origins

[size=5][color=#6d9eeb][b]Main Modifications[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Small Scarce Fields:[/b] ﻿Asteroids are now rare. No more pulse jumping through hundreds of fields, or leaving planet atmospheres with layers of asteroids. Finding an asteroid field is rare. Finding large asteroids is even rarer. Asteroids are also a bit smaller and spaced apart.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Bigger Rewards:[/b] Since asteroids are rarer and smaller in number, they drop larger amounts of Tritium. They also drop larger amounts of Gold, Silver and Platinum to make them a better source of trade. [/size]
[*][size=3][b]Stronger and Tougher:[/b] Asteroids now take a hit and have larger health points. Phase beam and other weapon modifications are more important to be more efficient at mining. [/size]
[*][size=3][b]Dangerous and Hazardous:[/b] Be careful flying through asteroids. They can easily destroy your ship's shields and health. No longer do asteroids slightly dent your shields. Hitting just a couple can lead to death. Shield modifications are more important now. [/size]
﻿[/list]
[center][url=https://gifyu.com/image/67QT][img]https://s1.gifyu.com/images/ezgif.com-gif-maker98fc89b46938ece1.gif[/img][/url]
[b]
Photon Cannon mining on a new survival save, no modifications may take a while but still possible for early game mining.[/b]

[url=https://gifyu.com/image/67Qh][img]https://s1.gifyu.com/images/ezgif.com-gif-maker-136faafe0a0ff52da.gif[/img]
[/url]
[b]Phase Beam mining on a more advanced save with a couple of modifications. [/b][/center]

[size=5][color=#f1c232][b]Visual Changes[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Better Explosions: [/b]The visual effects for the explosions were meticulously tinkered with to make the explosions feel good and dynamic. The rock debris are smaller and stay around longer. They also do not spin at 9999 mph. The cloud fx was made bigger, and the red glowing sparks now begin bright yellow and fade into red to emulate heat cooling down. [/size]
[*][size=3][b]Shaking:[/b] Camera shaking was added when you destroy asteroids to further add to the feel. [/size]
[*][size=3][b]Rocket Launchers: [/b]Explosions were increased in size. [/size]
[/list]
[size=4][color=#674ea7][b]Current Version: Origins

Future Stuff:[/b]
- Add new types of asteroids
- Large asteroid variation, better drops
- Add new types of POI
- Comets
- Custom effects

[/color][/size][size=6][b][color=#e06666]FAQ:[/color]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]I can't destroy the asteroids:[/b]
They are purposefully strong so that you have to use phase beam, photon cannon or other ship weapon modifications to amp up your power. After a few modifications, you should be able to destroy an asteroid in a one hit. 

[b]Won't it be harder to gather Anomaly Detectors with less asteroids?[/b]
Anomaly Detectors are much more common now so you shouldn't have issues finding them in scarce fields of asteroids.

[b]Is this mod incompatible with other asteroid mods?[/b]
It's not compatible with other asteroid mods since this mod edits the same MBIN files.

[/size][b]MBIN files used in the mod:[/b]
GCSOLARGENERATIONGLOBALS.GLOBAL
SPACEEFFECTS
DAMAGETABLE
ASTEROIDEXPLODE.SCENE
BANGEMITTER.PARTICLE
GLOWSPARKSEMITTER.PARTICLE
SMOKEEMITTER.PARTICLE

name: Refiner Inputs Expanded
summary: (6.03 Compatible) More complex refinement, on the go! Increases the number of inputs for all refiners to 3. Customizable with AMUMSS.
author: alchemist1654
description:
[size=5]Refiner Inputs Expanded[/size]

Increases the number of inputs for all refiners to 3. Customizable with AMUMSS.

[color=#00ffff][size=4]FEATURES // SIDE EFFECTS[/size][/color]

Each refiner reacted to this change a little differently. I think I have found all the quirks but if you find any more be sure to post them so I can update the docs.
[list]
[*]Removing the mod for a given refiner type will destroy the contents of the extra input slots for that type. Empty your refiners before mod-breaking updates or if you want to remove the mod.[/*]
[*]I take no responsibility for lost things.[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Backpack[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Personal Refiner (Mk. 1) Input count increased from [b]1[/b] to [b]2[/b].[/*]
[*]Personal Refiner (Mk. 2) Input count increased from [b]2[/b] to [b]3[/b].[/*]
[*]Fuel duration increased from [b]5 minutes[/b] to [b]15 minutes[/b]. A refiner will automatically finish whatever it is working on if it runs out fuel mid-construction and give you the result. Since, by default, some 3 input products take longer than 5 minutes, I increased the time so you weren't forced to abuse that mechanic if you didn't want to.[/*]
[*]Can only drag and drop from the inventory screen if all inputs are empty. Processing starts automatically so don't do this for recipes with 2+ ingredients. I have no control over how this works.[/*]
[*]I cannot remove the fuel requirement. It breaks the UI for this refiner, preventing you from using all the inputs and other strangeness.[/*]
[*]I cannot make it so both refiners can be installed at the same time, as they are technically the same refiner with a different interface.[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Portable[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Input count increased from [b]1[/b] to [b]3[/b].[/*]
[*]Fuel requirement removed, or else you could not pick it back up again. While it didn't break the UI, it (sort of) disables the pick-up safety protocols.[/*]
[*]If you have 2+ inputs filled, it cannot be picked up.[/*]
[*]If you have 1 or none inputs filled, anything in the [b]OUTPUT WILL BE DESTROYED[/b]. The input is returned to you.[/*]
[*][b]EMPTY YOUR REFINER BEFORE PICK UP![/b][/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Base Medium[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Input count increased from [b]2[/b] to [b]3[/b].[/*]
[*]It works just like the big one. No known complications.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]GETTING STARTED[/size][/color]

[b][color=#ff7700]Installation[/color][/b]

This mod is provided as either pre-built mod folder or as *.lua scripts for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/957]AMUMSS[/url]. Please compare the files listed below to your existing mods. If you have any conflicts, you must use AMUMSS to create a combined build for conflict resolution.

[list]
[*][b]Downloaded mod[/b] ~ Extract the zip contents into [u]<No Man's Sky>\GAMEDATA\MODS[/u].[/*]
[*][b]AMUMSS[/b] ~ Place *.lua files in your [u]ModScript[/u] folder, along with the .lua for any conflicting mods, and then execute [u]BUILDMOD.bat[/u] for perfect conflict resolution. Additional information is available at the [url=https://stepmodifications.org/wiki/NoMansSky:AMUMSS_Guide]AMUMSS Guide[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Conflict Files[/color][/b]

[b]BACKPACK[/b]
[list]
[*]MODELS/COMMON/PLAYER/PLAYERCHARACTER/PLAYERCHARACTER/ENTITIES/PLAYERCHARACTER.ENTITY.MBIN[/*]
[*]METADATA/REALITY/TABLES/NMS_REALITY_GCTECHNOLOGYTABLE.MBIN[/*]
[/list]
[b]PORTABLE[/b]
[list]
[*]MODELS/PLANETS/BIOMES/COMMON/BUILDINGS/PARTS/BUILDABLEPARTS/TECH/REFINER/ENTITIES/REFINER1.ENTITY.MBIN[/*]
[/list]
[b]BASE MEDIUM[/b]
[list]
[*]MODELS/PLANETS/BIOMES/COMMON/BUILDINGS/PARTS/BUILDABLEPARTS/TECH/REFINER/ENTITIES/REFINER2.ENTITY.MBIN[/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]THANKS[/size][/color]

[list]
[*]Hello Games for galaxies, stars, and all the worlds and life within.[/*]
[*]monkeyman192, WinderTP, and team for MBinCompiler so we can see behind the curtain.[/*]
[*]Mjjstral, Wbertro, and team for AMUMSS, making it easier to tug on the threads.[/*]
[/list]

name: Faster Scanning v6.45
summary: Scan anything faster!
author: Flugelwulff
description:
Lets you scan things faster with the analyzer. 1 second and instant options available as well as the option to disable the delay between scans.


[b][u]HOW TO INSTALL:
[/u][/b]1. Install with Vortex (strongly recommended - just do it)
2. Choose scan speed
3. Profit

LUA file is available for those who wish to change the multiplier themselves or merge it with other mods.

1.0: Sorry to anyone trying to download when I first uploaded. Added option to chose speeds. Fixed selection screen image being broken.
1.0.1: Modified "Instant" from "0.1" sec. to actually instant after testing stability
Added LUA file for use with AMUMSS (for merging)
1.1.0: Added ability to remove the delay between scans (added to LUA as well)
Added link to description to custom LUA
Added Custom LUA as optional file
5.02: Removed Custom LUA as the additional changes are now changable in-game and that code no longer works.

6.12: Overhaul to LUA structure & updated version number

name: RU_FIX
summary: Исправление многочисленных огрехов русской локализации.
author: play6ner
description:
[center][font=Georgia]Modification is focused on Russian-speaking audience, so I assume the knowledge of Russian by the visitor of this page ;)[/font]
[font=Georgia](модификация ориентирована на русскоязычную аудиторию, поэтому я предполагаю знание русского языка посетителем этой страницы)
[color=#ff7700][size=5]
РАБОТА НАД ПОДДЕРЖКОЙ И РАЗВИТИЕМ МОДА ОТЛОЖЕНА НА НЕОПРЕДЕЛЁННЫЙ СРОК
! Модификация не адаптирована под патч 4.30+ !
[/size][/color]
[/font]Поиграв пару часиков в эту замечательную игру, я начал замечать досадные неточности и несогласования в обозначениях, наименованиях, терминах и прочем таком. Литературная часть официальной локализации вполне удобоварима, хотя тоже требует определённых правок. Чем я тоже не премину заняться. На данном же этапе я сосредоточился на главном - том, что постоянно перед глазами и чем мы с вами постоянно пользуемся.[font=Arial]
[/font][/center][left][size=3]Предупрежу сразу, что глаз мой не так остёр, как я всем рассказываю, поэтому многое осталось вне фокуса. Но уж когда попадёт в него - я разберусь.[/size]
[size=3]Философская часть закончена, теперь кратко о главном.
[/size]

name: CleanHUD VR
summary: Removing/scaling icons, compass, health/shield bars and and other HUD elements - made for VR.
author: enifleR
description:
First of all - This is my first mod for No Man's Sky. Mistakes and errors may (or may not) occur and notices regarding them are kindly received.
The mod is largely based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1563]Clean HUD_The Traveller (Immersive Design)[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/users/86530598]hilightnotes[/url] - Big credits to this guy for giving permission, and helping out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/etmult2.jpg[/img]


I missed playing in VR with no/minimal HUD, but retaining some information, keeping other elements in as well as implenting some QOL features.
Since mods haven't been updated or new ones created that works with the Singularity update, I took myself on a modding-journey.

Features:
- [s]Removed Health/Shield bars ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿(Moved to Binoculars)[/s] 
- Removed Mission Objectives ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿(Moved to Binoculars)
- Removed Jetpack/Stamina Indicators ﻿ ﻿(Moved to Binoculars)
- Removed Interaction circle, spline and light when interacting with objects
- Removed Labels and label-lines
- Removed "Out-of-area" Warning
- Compass adjusted to chest-level and downscaled
- Icon sizes reduced
- Inventory screen adjusted
- Leaning enabled
- Gamewindow disabled ﻿ ﻿ ﻿(No longer shows a big screen on desktop, but only a small empty one)
- (W.I.P) Player Interaction-cam ﻿    (This one has its drawbacks. Works great in some cases, less so in others)
- Various other small QOL stuff

This is very much still a work-in-progress, un-tested in flatscreen. I am still trying to flesh out some parts, but its a struggle! (Again, first mod). 
Feel free to make requests and report any issues, and I'll see what I can do!

[b]This mod is split up in 4 files:[/b]


[list]
[*]- __CleanHUDVR_Main_x.xxx.pak (Mandatory)
[*]- __CleanHUDVR_Add_InterCamOn_x.xxx.pak (Optional)
[*]- __CleanHUDVR_Add_InterCamOff_x.xxx.pak (Optional)
[*]- __CleanHUDVR_Add_NoBG_x.xxx.pak (Optional)
[/list]
Download the MAIN file, and one of the InterCam files (also choose NoBg if you want to remove backgrounds in menus etc).

[size=3][u]Choose whether you want the regular interaction cam (InterCamOff), or the player-attached cam (InterCamOn)[/u].
[/size][b][size=3](Do NOT choose both!)[/size]
[/b]
No background add-on for inventory and various other screens. (Some may struggle to see text in white landscapes etc).

[b]Player Interaction Cam[/b] - Forces the interacting with NPCs, Shops etc to NOT teleport the player out of their current position. 
One downside is, that the interactionscreen will move with NPCs, which can be disorienting and annoying. For me its tolerable for the most part, but worst interacting with the NPC sending Frigates on missions.
I'm still trying to solve that moving-part, but haven't quite figured it out yet (Any help in this regard is highly appreciated). 
Use it if you want to try it out. If not, use the regular-cam version.

I HIGHLY Recommend using this mod with:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1093/]Exosolar's Clear Visor Scanner and Surveyor[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/users/58018181]Exosolar
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1285]Small Panels[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/users/87374]Lo2k[/url] 

[b]LUA[/b]: [s]I have no experience or skill in this area, so don't expect one unless someone is willing to make one.[/s] 
Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/users/62067056]Babscoole[/url] for providing a LUA for this mod!

[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size][/color]

name: Supercharge Multiplier
summary: Supercharged slots, properly supercharged. This mod boosts the supercharged slot bonus from 1.25x to 3x, turning those hallowed squares into something you actually plan around. Use with care, especially with starships. Updated for and playtested on No Man's Sky 6.45.1.
author: NilOutput
description:
[b][size=6]Supercharge Multiplier[/size][/b]
Supercharged slots are one of the most exciting systems in late-game No Man's Sky — until you do the math and realize the bonus is a modest 1.25x. This mod reworks that number into 3.25x, so the slots earn the name. Drop your best S-class modules into supercharged slots and feel the difference.

[b][size=5]A Warning Worth Reading[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Maneuverability modules become powerful[/b] - a 3.25x boost on pitch/roll can make some ships twitchy[/*]
[*][b]Weapon modules hit hard[/b] - don't expect a vanilla-tuned combat pace[/*]
[*][b]Balance at your own risk[/b] - this is a deliberate "make it bigger" mod[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Technical Details[/size]
[/b]
Compatible with No Man's Sky version 6.33 and later. Modifies [font=Courier New]SpecialTechSlotBonus[/font] in [font=Courier New]GCGAMEPLAYGLOBALS.GLOBAL.MBIN[/font]. No save data touched. Safe to install or remove at any time.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size]
[/b]
Install in the No Man's Sky MODS directory or via Vortex. Lua script included, so you have complete control!

[b][size=5]Acknowledgements[/size]
[/b]
Thanks to the NMS modding community — tools like AMUMSS and MBINCompiler make mods like this possible. This one's a Lua script I've been running personally for a while, now published as part of a Nexus collection. If it exactly duplicates someone else's work, that's unintentional — ping me and I'll credit or pull it.

name: HUD shows the pinned log mission not a guide
summary: You already know that you can summon your ship, but it requires fuel? What about using a planetary chart? Knew that too? Want to see the mission you've chosen at all times? I got ya!
author: Thirt3nth
description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The HUD significantly less frequently* switches to something you didn't choose on its own. If you want to see the progress in culling creatures mission - you will. If you want to see the main story mission objective - you will. You decide what is on your screen, not HG. To cycle through active guides - press H.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]*Significantly less frequently - it still rarely switches to some guides (at least I saw it switching to exosuit scan guide after activating analysis visor), say hello to Hello Games, I guess. Also some missions consider themselves _very important_ and want to stay in the HUD even if another mission is chosen as the active one (I look at you "A Trace of Metal"). And the mission shown will change if you pick up a new mission of course, just because it automatically changes your pinned mission in the log.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]put into `No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\MODS[/color]
